author: Mark Atwood
text: DECOMPOSITION 2026-05-12 (Mark, interactive): the 6 buried-in-description decisions surfaced earlier in this session have been filed as discrete child decision beads for visibility on the human-frontier list. Children filed: .1 (lint granularity), .2 (severity mapping), .3 (batch interface shape), .4 (error-handling policy), .5 (pkix-policy-oscal file or skip), .6 (code-share with pkix-difftest oracles). NOTE: these are decision beads, not the implementation children. The implementation work for pkix-policy-zlint and pkix-policy-pkilint will be filed as separate epics WHEN the relevant gating decisions land — most of these decisions need to resolve before implementation can start coherently. Original 'three candidate adapter crates' framing in this epic's description (the .1/.2/.3 sub-sections under 'What') is retained as architectural-intent documentation; the actual decision children now have the per-decision detail.
